headline: US stocks set for modestly higher open as futures edge up ahead of September CPI data and major bank earnings
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) rise 0.13%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) rise 0.18%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) rise 0.05%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) rise 0.25%, indicating a slightly higher open
- September CPI is due at 8:30 AM ET and is expected to influence Federal Reserve interest rate expectations
- Bank of America (BAC), Morgan Stanley (MS), BlackRock (BLK), Progressive (PGR), Fastenal (FAST), and State Street (STT) are scheduled to report earnings before the bell
- ASML (ASML) is in focus after Q3 results showed a raised sales forecast but a revenue miss
- Asian shares edged higher overnight as the recent chip-related selloff showed signs of easing
- European equity markets opened modestly positive in early trading
- Oil (@CL) prices ticked up amid Middle East supply concerns
